planets.name: TOI-237 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-237 with a 5.44-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-237 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-237. Its orbit and size follow Waalkes et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
